title: 10 July 1963: Live: Winter Gardens, Margate
content:
The third of six consecutive nights for The Beatles at Margate’s Winter Gardens took place on 10 July 1963.

They played to two different ‘houses’ each night, performing nine songs: ‘Roll Over Beethoven’, ‘Thank You Girl’, ‘Chains’, ‘Please Please Me’, ‘A Taste Of Honey’, ‘I Saw Her Standing There’, ‘Baby It’s You’, ‘From Me To You’, and ‘Twist And Shout’.

Page last updated: 25 January 2024
